title: Spec of a quotient ring is a closed immersion
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. The morphism of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ induced by the quotient map $A\to A/I$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
